dogs.name: Buddy
dogs.story: Buddy arrived at Paws Haven as a stray and quickly became a favourite with staff and volunteers. He loves long walks, fetch and meeting new people, and he would thrive in a family with a garden and plenty of time for play.
dogs.alt: Buddy, a medium-sized brown dog available for adoption

dogs.name: Luna
dogs.story: Luna was surrendered when her previous owner moved away. She is happiest curled up beside her people and would suit a quiet home, a retired person or a couple who wants a loyal lap companion.
dogs.alt: Luna, a small scruffy terrier mix available for adoption

dogs.name: Max
dogs.story: Max is a bundle of energy who is still learning his manners. He needs daily exercise, patient training and a secure garden, and he will reward the right owner with endless enthusiasm.
dogs.alt: Max, a large tan Labrador mix available for adoption

dogs.name: Daisy
dogs.temperament: Curious, gentle, loves a good sniff.
dogs.story: Daisy follows her nose everywhere and is happiest on a long, slow walk. She is gentle, house-trained and gets along well with other dogs, so she would fit into a busy household.
dogs.alt: Photo of Daisy, a medium-sized Beagle mix, coming soon

dogs.name: Rocky
dogs.story: Rocky may look tough, but he is a big softie who adores human company. He has completed basic obedience training and is ready for an owner who can offer calm, consistent guidance.
dogs.alt: Photo of Rocky, a large Staffie mix, coming soon

dogs.name: Bella
dogs.temperament: Playful puppy, still learning the basics.
dogs.story: Bella was born at the shelter after her mother was rescued while pregnant. She is vaccinated and learning to walk on a lead, and she needs a family with time for puppy training and socialising.
dogs.alt: Photo of Bella, a small Maltese mix puppy, coming soon
